description: Check whether domain names can be registered through AIvikings. Takes a list of one or more names (up to 200). Each result has a status: available (confirmed free by the registry), probably_available (not registered as far as we can see, but NOT confirmed: lists of more than 50 names are not sent to the registry; check the shortlist again to confirm), taken, not_offered (AIvikings does not sell that TLD), invalid (see message), or try_again (could not be confirmed right now). Never tell the user a probably_available name is available. This tool does not return prices or premium status: before the user buys, always call get_domain_pricing for the chosen name and tell them if it is premium. For a single name or a short list (up to 10), include_price=true adds premium and prices in the same call.
name: check_domain_availability
